Jon (SRE): Postmortem follow-up: recurring private-customer RPC failures tied to VPC peering. Symptoms point to MTU/fragmentation + asymmetric return path. Need owners, quick ETA, and an oncall checklist.

Priya (Eng-Infra): I'll own the peering health probe and runbook snippet. Will add MTU probe + fragment detection. ETA: 48h.

Hitoshi (Private Deploy): I'll own agent mitigation (MSS clamp toggle + handshake retry). Will prepare opt-in patch and canary. ETA: this sprint, can fast-track with pcaps.

Leah (CSE): I'll gather affected customer list and upload pcaps to INC-5177. Customers agreed to run captures.

inc-bot: INC-5177 created and assigned to: Jon, Priya, Hitoshi. Priority: P2.

Jon (SRE): Runbook quick checks to include:
- ping -M do -s <size> <peer-ip>
- sudo tcpdump -n -s0 'ip[6:2] & 0x3fff != 0' -c 50
- cloud peering state check (aws/az/gcp CLI)

Priya (Eng-Infra): PR for probe will point to infra-monitoring so we get scheduled checks.

Hitoshi (Private Deploy): Agent flag default false; ops can flip during incident. Canary mirrors 1% traffic.

Jon (SRE): Action recap:
- Priya: probe + runbook (48h)
- Hitoshi: agent patch + canary (ETA sprint end)
- Leah: pcaps + configs (ETA tomorrow)

Please ack with :thumbsup: if you accept. We'll use this thread as canonical tracker and escalate to weekly 15m if INC-5177 remains open after a week.
